name: Eve
role: First woman, called “Mother Eve” in section 138
dateNote: Section 138 records Joseph F. Smith’s vision of 3 October 1918.
importance: The vision in section 138 lists Eve among the righteous dead in the spirit world. It calls her “our glorious Mother Eve” and places her with “many of her faithful daughters” who worshiped the true God. She appears beside “Father Adam” in the same congregation.
connections: Section 138 names her next to Adam.
reviewNote: Checked D&C 138:38–39 on the official page. Described only as the vision presents her.
